''See also: [[Sopharanatoth Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Sopharanatoth, also known as Sophara, is a powerful [[dragon]] belonging to the gold bloodline. As a [[Truegold]], she possesses a unique appearance that blends human and draconic features; her face is largely human except for her eyes and patches of [[scales]] on her cheeks, though she also has [[scale]] patches on her limbs, claw-like nails, and a thin golden tail. She is distinguished by her [[soulfire]] and the intense heat that flows through her veins. Sophara has served in high-ranking roles, such as an [[Underlord]] supervising the entrance to [[Ghostwater]]. She is a formidable combatant and a leading figure in her [[gold dragon team]], often ranked in the first position. Her abilities include the use of [[sacred arts]], [[soulfire]], and various [[madra]] types, including fire. In combat, she has demonstrated extreme speed, physical strength, and the ability to use specialized tools like a floating disc for protection. Despite her immense power and status as one of the most favored competitors in certain tournaments, she has faced significant personal tragedy, including the loss of her sister, [[Ekeri]]. She is also known to possess a unique [[void key]] that functions as a home and can store massive objects, such as the corpse of a [[Dreadgod]].}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Sopharanatoth is a [[dragon]] of the gold bloodline with wings, a tail, and golden eyes. In her human form, she possesses patches of gold [[scales]] on her cheeks and the backs of her hands. Her [[dragon]] form features a snout and a head larger than the [[Herald]]'s entire body.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|As the leader of the [[gold dragon team]], Sophara is a prominent competitor in tournaments and fighting competitions. She is an opponent who has caused fear in others, including [[Lindon]].}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Sophara is the daughter of [[Akura Malice]]. She is a competitor and opponent to [[Lindon]], [[Mercy]], and [[Yerin]], with the latter two seeking to defeat her. Additionally, [[Fury]] is responsible for killing Sophara's great-aunt.}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Sophara follows the [[Path of the Flowing Flame]] and utilizes various techniques such as [[Azure Moon Reigns]], [[Crimson Sun Rises]], [[Riverflame Dance]], [[Nightworm Venom]], and [[Strings of Shadow]]. She uses a [[Madra Engine]] to process [[blood]] and [[life essence]] into [[madra]], employs [[Ghostwater|ghostwater]], and wields the [[Quickriver]] [[technique]] in both saber and short [[sword]] forms. Additionally, she possesses an [[Imperial Aegis]], a floating disc that provides near immunity to [[Striker techniques]], and the ability to turn into [[white light]] to disperse.}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|Post-tournament conflicts}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|Sopharanatoth of the [[Gold dragons|gold dragons]] wields the Totem of the Dragon King{{!}}Dragon King’s Totem and previously used the [[Endless Sword]] to protect an unconscious [[Lindon]].<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c26">''Wintersteel'', chapter 26</ref> Utilizing the short, broad [[sword]] [[Quickriver]] and an [[Imperial Aegis]], she has the ability to disperse by turning into [[white light]].<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c26" /> As a finished [[sacred artist]] whose [[spirit]] is characterized by gold light condensing over her head, she employs an [[Enforcer technique]] involving a shield and a liquid whip.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c26" /><ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c27">''Wintersteel'', chapter 27</ref> After clashing with [[Mercy]] on a narrow [[stone]] ridge and intercepting [[Lindon]] with her tail, she transitioned from the arena to an assassination attempt against [[Mercy]] and [[Lindon]].<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c27" /><ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c28">''Wintersteel'', chapter 28</ref> During her fight with [[Lindon]], she used [[Quickriver]] to pour [[madra]] into a [[binding]] before eventually facing him in a hopeless state.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c28" />}}
